summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares U.S. Industry Rotation Active ETF (INRO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of US equities. The portfolio rotates towards industries that BlackRock believes are best positioned for outperformance INRO was launched on Mar 26, 2024 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: INRO is an equity ETF with a total of 305 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.04%, Apple at 7.89%, Microsoft at 5.66%, Alphabet at 5.41%, and Amazon.com at 3.47%.
